name: Chinese Government Scholarship (Bilateral Program)
host: China Scholarship Council (via your country's dispatching authority)
amount: Tuition, dorm, monthly stipend (flights not covered)
dlText: Set by each dispatching authority (often Jan – Apr) · Pakistan (HEC): expected ~early Jan 2027
nominationBody: Your country's dispatching authority (e.g. HEC in Pakistan) or the Chinese embassy

countryNotes.PK: Via HEC (Type A). Last cycle closed 5 Jan 2026, 16:00 PKT with 75 seats (35 bachelor's, 25 master's, 15 PhD). Apply on both the HEC and CSC portals or you'll be disqualified.

note: Apply through the scholarship agency or Chinese embassy in your country and on the CSC portal. Direct university (Type B) applications run separately.

name: MEXT Undergraduate Scholarship (Embassy Recommendation)
amount: Tuition, monthly allowance and airfare (amounts in the official guidelines)
dlText: 2027 round closed: embassy deadlines were ~late May – early Jun 2026 (e.g. US 31 May, Ireland 2 Jun)
nominationBody: The Japanese embassy or consulate in your country

countryNotes.PK: Apply through the Embassy of Japan in Islamabad or the Consulate in Karachi.

fields: Most fields (5 years incl. 1 year of Japanese)
note: Five-year scholarship including a preparatory year of Japanese; most scholars start in April. Each embassy runs its own exams and dates, and some countries add age or grade rules.

name: Global Korea Scholarship – Undergraduate (GKS-U)
amount: Tuition, airfare, monthly allowance and a Korean-language year (check official guideline)
dlText: 2027 embassy track closed ~30 Sep 2026, 18:00 KST (date from embassy notices) · university-track dates vary

eligibility.note: Only citizens of countries in the GKS-U guideline (embassy and university tracks have separate lists)

note: Apply through a Korean embassy (embassy track) or a designated university (university track). You must graduate from high school by 31 Dec 2026 for the 2027 round. Korean citizens are not eligible.

name: Brunei Darussalam Government Scholarship
dlText: Expected ~15 Dec 2026 – 15 Feb 2027 (last round: 15 Dec 2025 – 15 Feb 2026)

eligibility.note: Primarily citizens of ASEAN, Commonwealth and OIC countries (the official wording says 'not limited to'); Bruneians and Brunei PRs not eligible

nominationBody: The Brunei embassy or high commission in your country
note: Mainly for international students' first degree. People who have already studied at a Brunei university are not eligible. Calls are usually announced Nov–Dec on the Brunei Ministry of Foreign Affairs site.

name: NUS ASEAN Undergraduate Scholarship
dlText: Scholarship window 1 Feb – 19 Mar 2027 (referee forms by 2 Apr)
tags: Must accept the MOE Tuition Grant
note: Considered automatically through your NUS admission application; shortlisted applicants are then invited to apply. Interviews Mar–Jul. International students who don't take the MOE Tuition Grant (which has a work bond) can't get NUS scholarships.

name: NTU ASEAN Undergraduate Scholarship
dlText: Same window as NTU admission: 15 Oct 2026 – 20 Jan or 19 Mar 2027 depending on your qualification
note: Apply for admission first, then submit the scholarship form in the same window. Not open to Singaporeans or non-ASEAN students.

name: KAIST Undergraduate Scholarship (International)
amount: Full tuition + ~US$300/month + national health insurance (per KAIST's 2023 guide; confirm)
dlText: Regular round 10 Nov 2026 – 14 Jan 2027, 18:00 KST (early round closed 22 Oct)
tags: Choose 'KAIST Scholarship' on the form (can't change later)
note: For international students finishing high school by Aug 2027. Scholarship recipients are announced with admission results.

name: POSTECH International Undergraduate Scholarship
amount: Tuition waiver (GPA ≥ 3.0 after year 1) + KRW 500,000/month living allowance + arrival support
dlText: Fall 2027 applications expected Mar–Apr 2027 (guidelines late Jan 2027)
note: Amounts are from the Fall 2026 intake and may change. The Spring 2027 round closed 2 Sep 2026.

name: TaiwanICDF International Higher Education Scholarship
host: Taiwan International Cooperation and Development Fund
amount: Full scholarship (check official page for what's covered)

eligibility.note: Only nationals of countries on the TaiwanICDF eligible list (Asia-Pacific, Africa, Latin America, Caribbean, some of Europe); bachelor's only for countries with diplomatic ties to Taiwan

note: Check the 2027 guidebook's country list before applying; it changes yearly.

name: MOE Taiwan Scholarship
dlText: Expected 1 Feb – 31 Mar 2027 (some Taiwan offices accept until 30 Apr)
tags: Apply via the Taiwan office in your country

eligibility.note: Citizens of countries where a Taiwan representative office runs the scheme; check with your local office

nominationBody: The Taiwan embassy / representative office in your country
note: Up to 4 years (UG), 2 (master's), 4 (PhD), max 5 years in total. Recipients usually can't hold other Taiwan university scholarships.

name: MOFA Taiwan Scholarship
dlText: Expected 1 Feb – 31 Mar 2027 (each embassy may set its own date, e.g. 16 Mar in 2026)

eligibility.note: Mainly students from countries with diplomatic relations with Taiwan; others only by special consideration

nominationBody: The Taiwan embassy in your country

name: HKU Entrance Scholarships (international undergraduates)
amount: Up to full tuition waiver + accommodation scholarship + living allowance for top students (2026 terms)
dlText: First-round evaluation: apply by 25 Nov 2026, 12:00 noon HKT (later applications until 25 Aug 2027, rolling)
note: Everyone who applies is considered; results come with the offer. Tuition for non-local students was HK$224,000–249,000 a year in 2026-27.

name: Belt and Road Scholarship (HKSAR Government, at HKU)

eligibility.note: Only nationals of participating Belt and Road countries; check HKU's page for the list

note: Government-funded; can be combined with an admission application to HKU.

name: Hon Ping Entrance Scholarship for Nigerian Students
amount: Full tuition + HK$305,000 living allowance per year (from 2026-27)
note: For Nigerian students with financial need admitted to HKU.
